Quick answer

Why do orders, invoices and deliveries disagree? Because each is owned by a different department and kept in a different system. Every handoff between them is a chance for a record to drift.

What fixes it? Verify first. Zonar OS™ reconciles the records and ties every finding to a source row. HALU™ then briefs the person who owns the gap, and a human decides what happens next.

Who owns which record

Each team is right about its own record.
The trail between them is nobody's.

The disagreement is rarely a mistake inside one system. It sits in the handoff from one department to the next.

FAQ

Orders, invoices and deliveries: common questions.

Why do orders, invoices and deliveries disagree?+
Each record is created by a different department in a different system. Sales or buying raises the order, operations or the warehouse records the delivery, and finance raises the invoice. Handoffs, manual edits and pricing changes between them leave the three records out of step.
What does it cost when they disagree?+
It depends on the business, so we do not quote a standard figure. Typical outcomes are revenue delivered but not billed, invoices disputed or credited, and time spent by several teams arguing over which record is right. An Operations Gap Check on your own files gives the real number.
How does Zonar OS find the mismatches?+
Zonar OS matches order, invoice and delivery files against each other with rule-based, repeatable logic. Every mismatch becomes a finding that points to its source rows, and only a completed, audited run is released.
Where do vendor invoices for IT spend fit?+
The same logic applies on the buying side. Licences and usage, contracts and vendor invoices are records owned by IT, procurement and finance, and they can disagree in the same way. The first live module covers orders, invoices and deliveries, and IT spend checks are scoped with you.
Who decides what happens after a finding?+
A person. HALU briefs the owner of each gap from the verified findings, and your team approves every action that matters. Every run, read and decision is logged.
